method: The pre-change parser was instrumented at decision 2993 during one complete cache-reuse pass. Token types, prediction mode, and the selected alternative were recorded; token, source, and diagnostic text were not retained in the published aggregate.
interpretation: On the frozen corpus, the loop exits only for Oracle's (+) outer-join marker and for TREAT. Every other parenthesized continuation was an argument list. The candidate therefore continues without prediction, exits on (+), keeps prediction for TREAT, and restores the original prediction after a syntax error.
